manage.title: Manage local agent devices
manage.description: Approve and revoke devices permitted to use your SSH hosts.

manage_http.title: Manage Agent HTTP policy
manage_http.description: Allow explicit private source IPs to connect by HTTP.

agent.title: Local Agent Access
agent.description: Pair a local AI tool using Ed25519 device keys. No API token or SSH secret export is required.
agent.howto: Install the CloudSSH Agent skill, then run this command on your local computer.
agent.httpHelp: HTTP works only for approved private source IPs; the client must explicitly use --allow-http.
agent.httpToggle: Permit HTTP from selected private IP ranges
agent.onlyPrivate: Use HTTPS or a trusted private-network source to configure this policy.
agent.notice: This does not weaken Ed25519 signatures or host permissions. Public connections require HTTPS.
agent.scopeWrite: File write permissions should be granted only when needed.
agent.scopeSudoWarning: Root execution is disabled by default. Grant it only to a trusted device; it can modify or delete anything on authorized servers. The ssh:sudo plugin capability must also be approved.
agent.confirmRevoke: Revoke and remove this device? Its active SSH connections will be closed. Audit records are retained.
agent.includeFutureHosts: Include future hosts in the selected folders
agent.allFutureHint: Includes all hosts you own now and add later. Other users' hosts remain excluded.
agent.futureHint: When enabled, new hosts in these folders inherit this grant. Older fixed grants remain unchanged until you enable this option.
agent.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the command and copy it manually.
